message.reasoning:
We need to solve: Boris has 100 apples. Pike (بيك) has 23 apples less than Boris. So initially Pike has 100 - 23 = 77 apples. Then Boris gives Pike 10 apples. So Boris loses 10, Pike gains 10.

After transfer: Boris: 100 - 10 = 90. Pike: 77 + 10 = 87.

Difference: Boris - Pike = 90 - 87 = 3 apples. So Pike has 3 apples less than Boris now.
